title: Two Things at Once: míg and miközben

sections.title: Describing Simultaneous Events in a War
sections.content: You know *míg* and *miközben* from B1 Unit 4. In a war narrative they show two things happening at the same time: *Míg a kurucok a hegyekben gyűltek, a labanc csapatok a síkságon vártak.* ('While the Kuruc gathered in the hills, the labanc troops waited on the plain.').

items.spanish: Míg a kurucok a hegyekben gyűltek, a labanc csapatok a síkságon vártak.
items.english: While the Kuruc gathered in the hills, the labanc troops waited on the plain.

items.spanish: A lovasok megindultak, miközben a falvakban ezrek csatlakoztak hozzájuk.
items.english: The riders set off while thousands in the villages joined them.
